workflows.title: Create and schedule a compliance test
workflows.purpose: Turn a control objective into an owned, recurring test.
steps: Open Testing Program and select Tests.
Click New test.
Choose the entity and category, then enter the test name and description.
Set the cadence and test type.
Add evidence questions in the questionnaire step.
Assign the owner and reviewer.
Review the setup and create the test.
Open the new test and confirm its schedule and next run.

workflows.title: Execute a test and document a finding
workflows.purpose: Collect evidence, review an outcome, and create a corrective finding.
steps: Open a test with an active run.
Start or continue the run.
Complete the evidence tasks and attach supporting documentation.
Record the outcome.
Create a finding for an exception, including owner, due date, and corrective action.
Open the Findings register and verify the new finding.

workflows.title: Add a control and link risks and tests
workflows.purpose: Build traceability from a control to its risks and testing activity.
steps: Open the Controls library.
Click New control.
Enter the control description, policy, and procedures.
Link the applicable risks.
Link or create the related tests.
Save the control and verify the relationships on its detail page.

workflows.title: Create a risk in the risk register
workflows.purpose: Document and score a compliance risk.
steps: Open the Risk register.
Click New risk.
Enter the risk name, description, and category.
Set inherent likelihood and impact.
Link mitigating controls.
Review residual risk and save.
Confirm the risk appears in the register.

workflows.title: Add a new employee
workflows.purpose: Create an employee profile and prepare it for compliance oversight.
steps: Open People Oversight and select the People directory.
Click Add employee.
Enter identity and employment details.
Assign the employee to the appropriate groups and role.
Save the profile.
Open the employee and verify their status and assignments.

workflows.title: Review an employee compliance profile
workflows.purpose: Review a person's certifications, disclosures, groups, and account connections.
steps: Open the People directory and search for an employee.
Open the employee profile.
Review status, CRD number, role, and group membership.
Review certifications and disclosures.
Open account connections and inspect connection health.
Document or initiate any needed remediation.

workflows.title: Create a certification campaign
workflows.purpose: Send a compliance attestation to the right employee population.
steps: Open Certifications.
Click New certification.
Enter the campaign name and instructions.
Build the questions and required attestations.
Choose recipient groups.
Set the launch and due dates.
Review and launch the campaign.
Confirm recipients and status on the campaign page.

workflows.title: Review a submitted disclosure
workflows.purpose: Evaluate an employee disclosure and record a decision.
steps: Open the disclosures review queue.
Filter to submitted disclosures.
Open a disclosure and review the employee's answers and attachments.
Add reviewer notes or request follow-up if needed.
Approve, reject, or escalate the disclosure.
Verify the updated status in the queue.

workflows.title: Add a new branch location
workflows.purpose: Create a branch and establish its regulatory profile.
steps: Open Branches.
Click Add branch.
Enter the branch name, address, and CRD number.
Set its OSJ and registration attributes.
Assign its supervisor and reporting relationship.
Save the branch.
Open the branch detail and verify its profile.

workflows.title: Schedule a branch exam
workflows.purpose: Plan and assign a branch examination.
steps: Open the target branch.
Open the Exams section.
Click Schedule exam.
Choose the exam template and date range.
Assign the inspector.
Review the scope and schedule the exam.
Confirm it appears in the exam calendar or queue.

workflows.title: Update branch personnel and sync FINRA data
workflows.purpose: Keep office assignments and regulatory data current.
steps: Open a branch and navigate to Personnel.
Review staff and supervisory assignments.
Add or transfer employees.
Save and verify the personnel list.
Trigger the FINRA sync using the branch CRD number.
Refresh the profile and verify updated regulatory fields.

workflows.title: Escalate or cancel a branch exam
workflows.purpose: Update an active branch exam when review circumstances change.
steps: Open the branch exam queue.
Select the active exam.
Review its current status and assignments.
Choose Escalate or Cancel.
Enter the required rationale.
Confirm the action.
Verify the new status in the exam queue.

workflows.title: Review and disposition a flagged communication
workflows.purpose: Investigate message context and complete a defensible review.
steps: Open the flagged communications queue.
Filter by channel, person, status, or rule.
Open a flagged result.
Review the surrounding conversation, triggered rule, and attachments.
Add a reviewer note.
Update the review status or escalate.
Open the audit trail and confirm the action.

workflows.title: Create and reuse a communications search
workflows.purpose: Run and save a targeted investigation across archived messages.
steps: Open Email or Instant Messages.
Set participants, keywords, date range, channel, and review status.
Run the search.
Open a result to review conversation context.
Save the filter set.
Return to search and reapply the saved filter.

workflows.title: Bulk update communication review status
workflows.purpose: Disposition multiple communications efficiently.
steps: Open a communications results list.
Apply filters to isolate the intended records.
Select multiple communications.
Choose the bulk review-status action.
Select the new status and add rationale if requested.
Confirm the update.
Verify the selected records now show the new status.

workflows.title: Submit marketing material for review
workflows.purpose: Create a project and submit a document for compliance review.
steps: Open Marketing projects and click New project.
Name the project and choose an approval workflow.
Upload the marketing document.
Add the project details and submit it.
Wait for extraction and AI analysis to complete.
Open the project and review document status and suggestions.

workflows.title: Resolve AI suggestions and approve a document
workflows.purpose: Evaluate flagged claims and record the review decision.
steps: Open My reviews and claim a pending document.
Open the document viewer.
Review each highlighted suggestion, its triggered rule, and proposed remediation.
Resolve valid suggestions and dismiss false positives with rationale.
Add a document note if needed.
Approve or reject the document.
Return to the dashboard and verify the queue changed.

workflows.title: Configure a marketing approval workflow
workflows.purpose: Define submission routing and approval stages.
steps: Open Marketing workflows and click New workflow.
Name the workflow and define eligible submitters.
Add approval stages.
Assign approver groups or required approvers.
Save the workflow and verify stage order.
Create a sample project and confirm the workflow is available.

workflows.title: Review and disposition a surveillance alert
workflows.purpose: Investigate a flagged trade and record the outcome.
steps: Open Account Surveillance alerts.
Filter by rule, account, client, date, or status.
Open an alert.
Review the rule, account, client, representative, and implicated trades.
Add reviewer analysis.
Close or escalate the alert with a resolution determination.
Return to the list and verify the status changed.

workflows.title: Create and run a surveillance rule
workflows.purpose: Configure detection logic and produce reviewable exceptions.
steps: Open Rule templates.
Choose a detection template.
Set thresholds, scope, and detection parameters.
Review and save the rule.
Verify it in the Rules list.
Start a rule run.
Open the completed run and review generated violations.

workflows.title: Investigate and export client trades
workflows.purpose: Trace activity from client to account and representative.
steps: Open Clients and search for a monitored client.
Open the client and review linked accounts and representatives.
Open the relevant account.
Open Trades and filter by client, account, security, side, and date.
Save the search or export the filtered trade blotter.
Open Company structure to show the relationships.

workflows.title: Create a manual exception from selected trades
workflows.purpose: Create a reviewable exception from an investigator-selected trade set.
steps: Open the Trades page.
Filter to the relevant account, security, and date range.
Select the trades that require review.
Choose Create manual exception.
Enter the reason and assign a reviewer.
Save the exception.
Open Alerts and verify the new exception.
